      --color-dark-hover: #1a4a8a;
    }
    * { touch-action: pan-y; }
    .pan-xy, .pan-xy * { touch-action: pan-x pan-y !important; }
    .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .no-scrollbar { scrollbar-width: none; }
    @keyframes pulse-dot { 0%, 80%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; } 40% { opacity: 1; } }
    .dot-pulse span { animation: pulse-dot 1.4s infinite; }
    .dot-pulse span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .dot-pulse span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }

    /* Markdown prose styling */
    .prose-dark { line-height: 1.7; font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .prose-dark > *:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
    .prose-dark > *:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .prose-dark p { margin: 0.6em 0; }
    .prose-dark h1, .prose-dark h2, .prose-dark h3, .prose-dark h4 {
      font-weight: 600; margin: 1.2em 0 0.4em; color: #e5e5e5;
    }
    .prose-dark h1 { font-size: 1.4em; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding-bottom: 0.3em; }
    .prose-dark h2 { font-size: 1.2em; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); padding-bottom: 0.25em; }
    .prose-dark h3 { font-size: 1.05em; }
    .prose-dark h4 { font-size: 1em; opacity: 0.9; }
    .prose-dark pre {
      background: #1c2333; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
      overflow-x: auto; margin: 0.75em 0; font-size: 0.82em;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .prose-dark pre code {
      background: none; padding: 0; font-size: inherit;
      border: none; border-radius: 0;
    }
    .prose-dark code {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
      border-radius: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.86em;
      color: #e0b0ff;
    }
    .prose-dark ul, .prose-dark ol { padding-left: 1.6em; margin: 0.5em 0; }
    .prose-dark ul { list-style: disc; }
    .prose-dark ol { list-style: decimal; }
    .prose-dark li { margin: 0.2em 0; }
    .prose-dark li > ul, .prose-dark li > ol { margin: 0.15em 0; }
    .prose-dark li > p { margin: 0.25em 0; }
    .prose-dark blockquote {
      border-left: 3px solid rgba(96,165,250,0.4); padding-left: 1em;
      margin: 0.6em 0; color: #9ca3af; font-style: italic;
    }
    .prose-dark a { color: #60a5fa; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; }
    .prose-dark a:hover { color: #93bbfd; }
    .prose-dark table { border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0.6em 0; font-size: 0.88em; width: 100%; }
    .prose-dark th, .prose-dark td {
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding: 0.4em 0.7em; text-align: left;
    }
    .prose-dark th { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); font-weight: 600; color: #d1d5db; }
    .prose-dark tr:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
    .prose-dark hr { border: none; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); margin: 1em 0; }
    .prose-dark strong { color: #f0f0f0; font-weight: 600; }
    .prose-dark em { color: #c4b5fd; }
    .prose-dark img { max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem; margin: 0.5em 0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body class="bg-dark-bg text-gray-200 font-sans h-full">

<div x-data="chatApp()" x-init="loadSessions()" class="flex h-full overflow-hidden">
<!-- Overlay (mobile) -->
<div x-show="sidebarOpen" x-transition.opacity
     @click="sidebarOpen = false"
     class="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-40 md:hidden"></div>

<!-- Sidebar -->
<div :class="sidebarOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'"
     class="fixed md:static md:translate-x-0 z-50 w-64 h-full bg-dark-sidebar border-r border-dark-accent p-4 flex flex-col overflow-hidden transition-transform duration-200">
  <button @click="newChat()" class="bg-dark-accent hover:bg-dark-hover text-gray-200 rounded-md py-2 px-3 text-sm mb-4 shrink-0">+ New Chat</button>
  <h2 class="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2 uppercase tracking-wide shrink-0">Sessions</h2>
  <div class="overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar pan-xy flex-1">
    <div class="w-max min-w-full">
      <template x-for="s in sessions" :key="s.session_id">
        <div @click="selectSession(s)"
             :class="s.session_id === sessionId ? 'bg-dark-accent' : ''"
             class="py-2 px-3 rounded-md cursor-pointer hover:bg-dark-accent mb-1">
          <div class="text-lg font-medium text-white whitespace-nowrap" x-text="s.first_prompt || s.summary || s.session_id.slice(0, 12)"></div>
          <div class="text-[0.65rem] text-gray-500" x-text="relativeTime(s.last_modified)"></div>
        </div>
      </template>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<!-- Main -->
<div class="flex-1 flex flex-col min-w-0 min-h-0">

  <!-- Toggle button (mobile) -->
  <button @click="sidebarOpen = !sidebarOpen"
          class="md:hidden fixed top-2 left-2 z-50 bg-dark-accent text-gray-200 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-lg">&#9776;</button>

  <!-- Messages -->
  <div x-ref="messages" x-effect="if (messages.length) $nextTick(() => $el.scrollTop = $el.scrollHeight)" class="flex-1 overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden p-4 flex flex-col gap-3" style="overscroll-behavior-x: none;">
    <template x-for="(msg, i) in messages" :key="i">
      <div>
        <!-- User message -->
        <template x-if="msg.type === 'user'">
          <div class="w-full bg-dark-accent border-l-[3px] border-blue-500 rounded-xl p-3 leading-relaxed break-words">
            <div class="text-[0.7rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70 mb-1">You</div>
            <template x-if="msg.images && msg.images.length">
              <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-2">
                <template x-for="(img, ii) in msg.images" :key="ii">
                  <img :src="'data:' + img.media_type + ';base64,' + img.data" class="max-h-40 rounded-lg">
                </template>
              </div>
            </template>
            <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap" x-text="msg.content"></div>
          </div>
        </template>

        <!-- Assistant message (structured blocks) -->
        <template x-if="msg.type === 'assistant'">
          <div class="w-full bg-neutral-800 border-l-[3px] border-amber-500 rounded-xl p-3 text-gray-300 leading-relaxed break-words">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <div class="text-[0.7rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70">Claude</div>
              <template x-if="msg.loading">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <div class="dot-pulse text-amber-400 text-lg leading-none"><span>.</span><span>.</span><span>.</span></div>
                  <div class="text-[0.65rem] text-gray-500" x-text="msg.elapsed + 's'"></div>
                </div>
              </template>
            </div>
            <template x-if="msg.blocks">
              <div class="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <template x-for="(block, bi) in msg.blocks" :key="bi">
                  <div>
                    <!-- Text block -->
                    <template x-if="block.type === 'text'">
                      <div class="prose-dark" x-html="renderMarkdown(block.content)"></div>
                    </template>
                    <!-- Thinking block (collapsible) -->
                    <template x-if="block.type === 'thinking'">
                      <details class="bg-neutral-900 rounded-lg">
                        <summary class="cursor-pointer px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-purple-400 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide select-none">Thinking</summary>
                        <div class="px-3 pb-2 text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-pre-wrap" x-text="block.content"></div>
                      </details>
                    </template>
                    <!-- Tool use block (collapsible) -->
                    <template x-if="block.type === 'tool_use'">
                      <details class="bg-neutral-900 rounded-lg">
                        <summary class="cursor-pointer px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-cyan-400 select-none">
                          <span x-text="block.name"></span>
                        </summary>
                        <div class="px-3 pb-2 text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap break-all" x-text="JSON.stringify(block.input, null, 2)"></div>
                      </details>
                    </template>
                  </div>
                </template>
              </div>
            </template>
            <!-- Streaming text (no blocks yet) -->
            <template x-if="!msg.blocks">
              <div class="prose-dark" x-html="renderMarkdown(msg.content.trim())"></div>
            </template>
          </div>
        </template>

        <!-- Error message -->
        <template x-if="msg.type === 'error'">
          <div class="w-full bg-red-950 border-l-[3px] border-red-500 rounded-xl p-3 text-red-200 leading-relaxed break-words">
            <div class="text-[0.7rem] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide opacity-70 mb-1">Error</div>
            <div class="whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono text-sm" x-text="msg.content"></div>
          </div>
        </template>

      </div>
    </template>
  </div>
    <!-- Image previews -->
    <template x-if="pendingImages.length">
      <div class="flex gap-2 px-4 pt-2 border-t border-dark-accent bg-dark-sidebar overflow-x-auto">
        <template x-for="(img, ii) in pendingImages" :key="ii">
          <div class="relative flex-shrink-0">
            <img :src="'data:' + img.media_type + ';base64,' + img.data" class="h-16 rounded-lg">
            <button @click="pendingImages.splice(ii, 1)" class="absolute -top-1 -right-1 bg-red-700 text-white rounded-full w-5 h-5 text-xs leading-none flex items-center justify-center">&times;</button>
          </div>
        </template>
      </div>
    </template>
    <!-- Input -->
    <div class="flex gap-2 p-4 md:p-4 p-2 border-t border-dark-accent bg-dark-sidebar">
      <input type="file" x-ref="fileInput" accept="image/*" multiple class="hidden" @change="addFiles($event.target.files); $event.target.value = ''">
      <button @click="$refs.fileInput.click()" class="bg-dark-accent hover:bg-dark-hover text-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 text-lg" title="Attach image">&#128247;</button>
      <textarea x-ref="prompt" x-model="prompt"
                @keydown.enter.prevent="if (!$event.shiftKey) sendMessage()"
                @paste="const img = [...($event.clipboardData?.items || [])].find(i => i.type.startsWith('image/')); if (img) { $event.preventDefault(); addFiles([img.getAsFile()]); }"
                @input="$el.style.height = 'auto'; $el.style.height = $el.scrollHeight + 'px'"
                placeholder="Send a message..." rows="1"
                class="flex-1 bg-dark-bg border border-dark-accent focus:border-dark-hover text-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-base md:text-sm resize-none min-h-[44px] max-h-[200px] outline-none"></textarea>
      <button x-show="!sending" @click="sendMessage()" :disabled="!prompt.trim() && !pendingImages.length"
              :class="(!prompt.trim() && !pendingImages.length) ? 'opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed' : 'hover:bg-dark-hover'"
              class="bg-dark-accent text-gray-200 px-5 rounded-lg text-base md:text-sm">Send</button>
      <button x-show="sending" @click="cancelQuery()" x-cloak
              class="bg-red-800 hover:bg-red-700 text-gray-200 px-5 rounded-lg text-base md:text-sm">Cancel</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
function relativeTime(dateStr) {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  const d = new Date(dateStr), now = new Date();
  const diffS = Math.floor((now - d) / 1000);
  if (diffS < 60) return 'just now';
  const diffM = Math.floor(diffS / 60);
  if (diffM < 60) return diffM + 'm ago';
  const diffH = Math.floor(diffM / 60);
  if (diffH < 24) return diffH + 'h ago';
  const diffD = Math.floor(diffH / 24);
  if (diffD === 1) return 'yesterday';
  if (diffD < 7) return diffD + 'd ago';
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
}

marked.setOptions({ gfm: true, breaks: true });
const renderer = new marked.Renderer();
renderer.code = function({ text, lang }) {
  let highlighted;
  if (lang && hljs.getLanguage(lang)) {
    highlighted = hljs.highlight(text, { language: lang }).value;
  } else {
    highlighted = hljs.highlightAuto(text).value;
  }
  return '<pre><code class="hljs">' + highlighted + '</code></pre>';
};
marked.use({ renderer });
function renderMarkdown(text) {
  if (!text) return '';
  return marked.parse(text);
}

function chatApp() {
  const appToken = document.querySelector('meta[name=app-token]').content;
  const authHeaders = { 'X-App-Token': appToken };
  return {
    sessionId: null,
    sessionCwd: null,
    sessions: [],
    messages: [],
    prompt: '',
    sending: false,
    sidebarOpen: false,
    pendingImages: [],

    relativeTime: relativeTime,

async loadSessions() {
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('api/sessions', { headers: authHeaders });
    this.sessions = await resp.json();
  } catch (e) {}
},

newChat() {
  this.sessionId = null;
  this.sessionCwd = null;
  this.messages = [];
  this.sidebarOpen = false;
},

async selectSession(s) {
  this.sessionId = s.session_id;
  this.sessionCwd = s.cwd || null;
  this.messages = [];
  this.sidebarOpen = false;
  try {
    const resp = await fetch(`api/sessions/${s.session_id}/messages`, { headers: authHeaders });
    const history = await resp.json();
    for (const m of history) {
      if (m.role === 'user') {
        this.messages.push({ type: 'user', content: m.content });
      } else {
        this.messages.push({ type: 'assistant', blocks: m.blocks || [{ type: 'text', content: m.content || '' }] });
      }
    }
    this.$nextTick(() => this.scrollToBottom());
  } catch (e) {}
},

scrollToBottom() {
  const el = this.$refs.messages;
  if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
},
fileToBase64(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const b64 = reader.result.split(',')[1];
      resolve({ media_type: file.type || 'image/png', data: b64 });
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
},

async addFiles(files) {
  for (const f of files) {
    if (f.type.startsWith('image/')) {
      this.pendingImages.push(await this.fileToBase64(f));
    }
  }
},

async sendMessage() {
  const text = this.prompt.trim();
  const images = this.pendingImages.slice();
  this.prompt = '';
  this.pendingImages = [];
  this.sending = true;

  this.messages.push({ type: 'user', content: text, images: images.length ? images : null });
  const assistantMsg = { type: 'assistant', content: '', loading: true, elapsed: 0 };
  this.messages.push(assistantMsg);
  const msgIdx = this.messages.length - 1;

  const timer = setInterval(() => { assistantMsg.elapsed++; }, 1000);
  try {
    const resp = await fetch('api/chat', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...authHeaders },
      body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: text, session_id: this.sessionId, cwd: this.sessionCwd, images: images.length ? images : undefined }),
    });

    if (!resp.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}: ${resp.statusText}`);
    }

    const reader = resp.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = '';

    while (true) {
      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });

      const lines = buffer.split('\n');
      buffer = lines.pop();

      let eventType = null;
      for (const line of lines) {
        if (line.startsWith('event: ')) {
          eventType = line.slice(7);
        } else if (line.startsWith('data: ') && eventType) {
          const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
          if (eventType === 'text') {
            this.messages[msgIdx].content += data;
          } else if (eventType === 'error') {
            this.messages.push({ type: 'error', content: data });
          } else if (eventType === 'cancelled') {
            this.messages[msgIdx].content += '\n\n*[Cancelled]*';
          } else if (eventType === 'done') {
            this.sessionId = data;
            this.loadSessions();
          }
          eventType = null;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    this.messages.push({ type: 'error', content: err.message });
  }
  clearInterval(timer);
  this.messages[msgIdx].loading = false;
  this.sending = false;
},
async cancelQuery() {
  await fetch('api/cancel', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: authHeaders,
  });
},
  };
}
</script>

</body>
</html>

Nomad job

The app runs as a Nomad job on the home server. Nomad injects the Python source and HTML template via its template stanza, and passes Vault AppRole credentials as environment variables. This way the app can pull Claude’s OAuth token from Vault at startup without any secrets baked into the image.

To debug locally (runs on http://localhost:5000 with DEBUG=1):

cd nomad/files/remoteclaude && nix develop . --command python3 app.py

To deploy (or redeploy after changes):

clk nd start remoteclaude

Access is protected by authz-check-path — the app is exposed to the network, so we need an authorization gate. To generate an access code:

clk authorizationserver generate remoteclaude sam-phone

variable "ROLE_ID" {
  type = string
}

variable "SECRET_ID" {
  type = string
}

locals {
  root     = "remoteclaude"
  job-name = "remoteclaude"
  repo     = file("jobs/conf/repo")
  memory   = 256
}

job "remoteclaude" {
  datacenters = ["dc1"]
  group "remoteclaude" {
    ephemeral_disk {
      size    = 50
      migrate = true
      sticky  = true
    }
    update {
      healthy_deadline  = "15m"
      progress_deadline = "25m"
    }
    network {
      port "http" {}
    }
    task "remoteclaude" {
      logs {
        max_files     = 2
        max_file_size = 10
        disabled      = false
      }
      driver = "docker"
      config {
        image_pull_timeout = "20m"
        image   = "${local.repo}/remoteclaude:0.1.4"
        command = "python3"
        args    = ["${NOMAD_TASK_DIR}/app.py"]
        ports   = ["http"]
      }
      template {
        destination = "local/app.py"
        data        = file("files/remoteclaude/app.py")
        right_delimiter = "}}}"
        left_delimiter = "{{{"
      }
      template {
        destination = "local/templates/index.html"
        data        = file("files/remoteclaude/templates/index.html")
        right_delimiter = "}}}"
        left_delimiter = "{{{"
      }
      env {
        PORT       = "${NOMAD_PORT_http}"
        HOME       = "${NOMAD_ALLOC_DIR}/data"
        VAULT_ADDR = "http://${attr.unique.network.ip-address}:8200"
        DEBUG = "0"
        ROLE_ID    = var.ROLE_ID
        SECRET_ID  = var.SECRET_ID
      }
      resources {
        cpu        = 200
        memory     = local.memory
        memory_max = local.memory * 2
      }
      service {
        name = "remoteclaude"
        tags = [
          "konix.gatherlogs=true",

          # ── Public router for PWA assets (no auth) ──
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.rule=Host(`konubinix.eu`) && (Path(`/${local.root}/manifest.json`) || Path(`/${local.root}/sw.js`) || Path(`/${local.root}/icon.svg`) || Path(`/${local.root}/icon-192.png`) || Path(`/${local.root}/icon-512.png`))",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.tls=true",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.tls.certresolver=https",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.entrypoints=https",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.middlewares=${local.job-name}",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-pwa.priority=200",

          # ── HTTPS router with ForwardAuth ──
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.rule=Host(`konubinix.eu`) && PathPrefix(`/${local.root}`)",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.tls=true",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.tls.certresolver=https",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.entrypoints=https",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.tls.domains[0].main=konubinix.eu",
          "traefik.http.routers.${local.job-name}-https.middlewares=auto-slash,authz-check-path,${local.job-name}",

          "traefik.http.middlewares.${local.job-name}.replacepathregex.regex=^/${local.root}/(.*)",
          "traefik.http.middlewares.${local.job-name}.replacepathregex.replacement=/$1",
        ]
        port = "http"
        check {
          port     = "http"
          name     = "remoteclaude-${node.unique.name}"
          type     = "http"
          path     = "/healthz"
          interval = "1m"
          timeout  = "30s"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

Vault configuration

Policy

The app only needs read access to its own credentials in Vault KV v2.

path "secret/data/remoteclaude/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}

vault policy write remoteclaude -<<EOF
path "secret/data/remoteclaude/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF

Success! Uploaded policy: remoteclaude

AppRole

vault write auth/approle/role/remoteclaude \
      token_policies="remoteclaude" \
      token_ttl=1h \
      token_num_uses=0 \
      token_max_ttl=4h \
      token_period=1h \
      secret_id_ttl=0

Success! Data written to: auth/approle/role/remoteclaude

Storing approle credentials in vault KV

vault kv put -mount=secret remoteclaude/approle \
  role_id="$(vault read -field role_id auth/approle/role/remoteclaude/role-id)" \
  secret_id="$(vault write -field secret_id -force auth/approle/role/remoteclaude/secret-id)"

========== Secret Path ==========
secret/data/remoteclaude/approle

Storing the OAuth credentials

Store the contents of ~/.claude/.credentials.json (the claudeAiOauth object) into Vault so the container can authenticate as you.

vault kv put -mount=secret remoteclaude/creds \
  accessToken="$(jq -r .claudeAiOauth.accessToken ~/.claude/.credentials.json)" \
  refreshToken="$(jq -r .claudeAiOauth.refreshToken ~/.claude/.credentials.json)" \
  expiresAt="$(jq -r .claudeAiOauth.expiresAt ~/.claude/.credentials.json)" \
  scopes="$(jq -c .claudeAiOauth.scopes ~/.claude/.credentials.json)" \
  subscriptionType="$(jq -r .claudeAiOauth.subscriptionType ~/.claude/.credentials.json)" \
  rateLimitTier="$(jq -r .claudeAiOauth.rateLimitTier ~/.claude/.credentials.json)"

Open security issues

Remaining issues that haven’t been addressed yet, roughly by severity.

No Content-Security-Policy header

No CSP is set. The page loads scripts from cdn.jsdelivr.net with SRI, but without a CSP header an XSS vulnerability could load arbitrary scripts. A CSP that restricts script-src to the known CDN origins would add another layer.

No input size limits

The /api/chat endpoint accepts arbitrary JSON with no size limits on prompt or images. An attacker could POST huge payloads to exhaust memory. Setting Quart’s MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH would fix this.

Credential file permissions

OAuth tokens are written to ~/.claude/.credentials.json with default permissions. In the container, HOME is set to ${NOMAD_ALLOC_DIR}/data, which may be readable by other tasks in the allocation.

subprocess inherits full environment

refresh_via_cli passes {**os.environ, ...} to claude auth login. This includes SECRET_ID, ROLE_ID, and other Nomad-injected variables. Passing a minimal environment instead would limit exposure.

ntfy over HTTP

Notifications (which may contain error details) are sent unencrypted over the local network to http://192.168.1.46:9705/n.

Tests

All tests run against the real claude_agent_sdk API. Pass credentials so the SDK can authenticate:

earthly --secret-file claude_creds=$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json +remoteclaude-test

Filter tests with --test "name1 name2" (substring match, space-separated).

Tests with a recorded cassette automatically run in mock mode (no credentials needed for those). Tests without a cassette run against the real API and their cassette is saved for future runs.

Earthfile

Run the tests in an Earthly container. Debian-based for Chromium/Playwright compatibility. Credentials are required for the real API:

earthly --secret-file claude_creds=$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json +remoteclaude-test
earthly --secret-file claude_creds=$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json +remoteclaude-test --test=image_upload
earthly --secret-file claude_creds=$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json +remoteclaude-test --test="image_upload streaming_text"
earthly --secret-file claude_creds=$HOME/.claude/.credentials.json +remoteclaude-test --real_api=1

The test file is tangled alongside the app so the Earthfile can COPY it directly from the build context.

VERSION 0.8
IMPORT /home/sam/prog/Earthfile AS e

remoteclaude-build:
    FROM e+alpine-python-user-venv --extra_packages "nodejs npm" --packages "quart claude-agent-sdk requests"
    RUN npm install --prefix /home/sam/.local @anthropic-ai/claude-code
    ENV PATH="/home/sam/.local/node_modules/.bin:${PATH}"
    ENV CLAUDE_CLI="/home/sam/.local/node_modules/.bin/claude"

remoteclaude-test-base:
    FROM python:3.12-slim
    RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y chromium && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    RUN pip install playwright quart requests hypercorn
    RUN playwright install chromium
    WORKDIR /app
    COPY app.py ./remoteclaude/
    COPY templates ./remoteclaude/templates
    COPY remoteclaude_test.py .
    ENV RC_APP_DIR=/app/remoteclaude
    ENV HOME=/root

remoteclaude-test:
    FROM +remoteclaude-test-base
    RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y nodejs npm && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    RUN pip install claude-agent-sdk
    RUN npm install --prefix /root/.local @anthropic-ai/claude-code
    ENV PATH="/root/.local/node_modules/.bin:${PATH}"
    ENV CLAUDE_CLI="/root/.local/node_modules/.bin/claude"
    RUN --secret claude_creds \
        mkdir -p /root/.claude && \
        printf '%s' "$claude_creds" > /root/.claude/.credentials.json
    RUN mkdir -p /app/cassettes
    ARG real_api=""
    IF [ -z "$real_api" ]
        COPY --if-exists cassettes/* ./cassettes/
    END
    ENV RC_CASSETTE_DIR=/app/cassettes
    ARG test=""
    RUN python remoteclaude_test.py $test
    SAVE ARTIFACT /app/cassettes AS LOCAL ./cassettes

Imports and setup

Tests run against the real claude_agent_sdk API. Playwright talks to the real Quart backend.

import asyncio

import os
import socket

import time

if "PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH" not in os.environ:

Helpers

from contextlib import contextmanager

Embedded test server

Tests run against the real Quart app. We locate the app directory, then import and start the real app in a daemon thread.

def find_free_port():
    with socket.socket() as s:
        s.bind(("", 0))
        return s.getsockname()[1]


APP_DIR = os.path.join(
    os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
    "..", "..", "perso", "nomad", "files", "remoteclaude",
)
if not os.path.isdir(APP_DIR):
    APP_DIR = os.environ.get(
        "RC_APP_DIR",
        os.path.expanduser("~/perso/perso/nomad/files/remoteclaude"),
    )

sys.path.insert(0, APP_DIR)
import app as real_app


def start_server():
    port = find_free_port()

    def run():
        from hypercorn.asyncio import serve
        from hypercorn.config import Config
        config = Config()
        config.bind = [f"127.0.0.1:{port}"]
        config.loglevel = "INFO"
        # shutdown_trigger prevents hypercorn from installing signal handlers
        # (which fail in non-main threads on Python 3.12+)
        asyncio.run(serve(real_app.app, config,
                          shutdown_trigger=lambda: asyncio.Future()))

    t = threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    time.sleep(1)
    return f"http://localhost:{port}"

Barrier helpers for deterministic testing

The app exposes debug endpoints (/api/debug/state, /api/debug/barrier, /api/debug/resume) that let tests synchronize with app state transitions. These helpers wrap the HTTP calls so test code reads naturally.

import requests as barrier_requests


def set_barrier(base_url, state):
    """Tell the app to pause when it enters this state."""
    barrier_requests.post(f"{base_url}/api/debug/barrier", json={"state": state})


def wait_for_state(base_url, state, timeout=30):
    """Poll until the app reaches the given state."""
    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r = barrier_requests.get(f"{base_url}/api/debug/state")
        if r.json()["state"] == state:
            return
        time.sleep(0.05)
    raise TimeoutError(f"App never reached state '{state}'")


def resume_app(base_url):
    """Release the app from its current barrier."""
    barrier_requests.post(f"{base_url}/api/debug/resume")

Test context manager

sdk_test is a context manager that wraps each test. Test code never calls it directly — the test runner applies it. It has three phases: setup, yield (test runs), and teardown.

The function uses noweb to assemble its parts:

@contextmanager
def sdk_test(name):
    """Reset app state and manage cassette mock/record per test."""
    global _cassette_interactions
    global _mock_cassette, _mock_query_index
    global _mock_list_sessions_index, _mock_get_session_messages_index
    try:
        real_app._chat_last_request = 0.0
        if real_app._chat_semaphore.locked():
            real_app._chat_semaphore.release()
        real_app._current_query_task = None
    except Exception:
        pass
    cassette_dir = os.environ.get("RC_CASSETTE_DIR")
    mock_active = False
    recording = False
    saved_funcs = {
        attr: getattr(real_app, attr)
        for attr in ("query", "list_sessions", "get_session_messages")
    }
    if cassette_dir:
        cassette_path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
        if os.path.exists(cassette_path):
            with open(cassette_path) as f:
                _mock_cassette = json.load(f)
            _mock_query_index = 0
            _mock_list_sessions_index = 0
            _mock_get_session_messages_index = 0
            install_sdk_mock()
            mock_active = True
            print(f"  MOCK: {cassette_path}")
        else:
            _cassette_interactions = []
            _cassette_query_done.set()
            install_sdk_recorder()
            recording = True
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        if mock_active:
            uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
            _mock_cassette = None
        if recording and _cassette_interactions is not None:
            _cassette_query_done.wait(timeout=30)
            os.makedirs(cassette_dir, exist_ok=True)
            path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                json.dump({
                    "test_name": name,
                    "recorded_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                    "interactions": _cassette_interactions,
                }, f, indent=2, default=str)
            print(f"  RECORDED: {path}")
            uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
        _cassette_interactions = None
Reset app state

Reset the rate limiter timestamp and release the concurrency semaphore so tests don’t interfere with each other.

global _cassette_interactions
global _mock_cassette, _mock_query_index
global _mock_list_sessions_index, _mock_get_session_messages_index
try:
    real_app._chat_last_request = 0.0
    if real_app._chat_semaphore.locked():
        real_app._chat_semaphore.release()
    real_app._current_query_task = None
except Exception:
    pass
Cassette mode selection

When RC_CASSETTE_DIR is set, decide per-test whether to mock or record. Save references to the original SDK functions so they can be restored later.

  • If a cassette file exists for this test: load it and install the mock (replays recorded interactions without hitting the real API).
  • If no cassette exists: initialize the recording state and install the recorder (wraps real SDK calls to capture interactions).
cassette_dir = os.environ.get("RC_CASSETTE_DIR")
mock_active = False
recording = False
saved_funcs = {
    attr: getattr(real_app, attr)
    for attr in ("query", "list_sessions", "get_session_messages")
}
if cassette_dir:
    cassette_path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
    if os.path.exists(cassette_path):
        with open(cassette_path) as f:
            _mock_cassette = json.load(f)
        _mock_query_index = 0
        _mock_list_sessions_index = 0
        _mock_get_session_messages_index = 0
        install_sdk_mock()
        mock_active = True
        print(f"  MOCK: {cassette_path}")
    else:
        _cassette_interactions = []
        _cassette_query_done.set()
        install_sdk_recorder()
        recording = True
Teardown: save cassette and restore SDK

After the test body runs, clean up:

  • Mock mode: uninstall the mock and restore the original SDK functions.
  • Record mode: wait for any in-flight async queries to finish (the recorder tracks pending queries via _cassette_query_done), then write the cassette JSON file and restore the original SDK functions.
if mock_active:
    uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
    _mock_cassette = None
if recording and _cassette_interactions is not None:
    _cassette_query_done.wait(timeout=30)
    os.makedirs(cassette_dir, exist_ok=True)
    path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        json.dump({
            "test_name": name,
            "recorded_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
            "interactions": _cassette_interactions,
        }, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"  RECORDED: {path}")
    uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
_cassette_interactions = None

SDK recorder

When a test has no cassette, sdk_test() monkey-patches the SDK functions to record every interaction to a per-test JSON cassette file and writes the cassette on exit.

_cassette_interactions = None
_cassette_pending_queries = 0
_cassette_query_done = threading.Event()
_original_query = None
_original_list_sessions = None
_original_get_session_messages = None


def serialize_sdk_object(obj):
    """Serialize SDK dataclass instances to JSON-compatible dicts."""
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj) and not isinstance(obj, type):
        d = dataclasses.asdict(obj)
        d["__type__"] = type(obj).__name__
        return d
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [serialize_sdk_object(item) for item in obj]
    return obj


async def recording_query(**kwargs):
    prompt_iter = kwargs.get("prompt")
    prompt_messages = []

    async def recording_prompt_iter():
        async for msg in prompt_iter:
            prompt_messages.append(
                serialize_sdk_object(msg) if dataclasses.is_dataclass(msg) else msg
            )
            yield msg

    new_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
    if prompt_iter is not None:
        new_kwargs["prompt"] = recording_prompt_iter()

    # Record eagerly: create the interaction entry up front so it's
    # visible even if the cassette is written from another thread
    # before the generator finishes cleanup.
    global _cassette_pending_queries
    options = kwargs.get("options")
    options_dict = serialize_sdk_object(options) if options else {}
    for key in ("stderr", "debug_stderr"):
        options_dict.pop(key, None)
    interaction = {
        "call": "query",
        "args": {"prompt": prompt_messages, "options": options_dict},
        "yielded": [],
    }
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append(interaction)
        _cassette_pending_queries += 1
        _cassette_query_done.clear()

    try:
        async for message in _original_query(**new_kwargs):
            interaction["yielded"].append(serialize_sdk_object(message))
            yield message
    finally:
        if _cassette_interactions is not None:
            _cassette_pending_queries -= 1
            if _cassette_pending_queries <= 0:
                _cassette_query_done.set()


def recording_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs):
    result = _original_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs)
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append({
            "call": "list_sessions",
            "args": {"limit": kwargs.get("limit", args[0] if args else None)},
            "returned": [serialize_sdk_object(s) for s in result],
        })
    return result


def recording_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs):
    result = _original_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs)
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append({
            "call": "get_session_messages",
            "args": {"session_id": session_id},
            "returned": [serialize_sdk_object(m) for m in result],
        })
    return result


def install_sdk_recorder():
    global _original_query, _original_list_sessions, _original_get_session_messages
    import claude_agent_sdk

    _original_query = claude_agent_sdk.query
    _original_list_sessions = claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions
    _original_get_session_messages = claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages

    claude_agent_sdk.query = recording_query
    claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions = recording_list_sessions
    claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages = recording_get_session_messages

    real_app.query = recording_query
    real_app.list_sessions = recording_list_sessions
    real_app.get_session_messages = recording_get_session_messages

SDK playback

When a cassette file exists for the current test, sdk_test() monkey-patches the SDK functions to replay recorded interactions instead of calling the real API. Mock activation is per-test: sdk_test() checks for a matching cassette and installs/uninstalls the mock around each test.

_mock_cassette = None
_mock_query_index = 0
_mock_list_sessions_index = 0
_mock_get_session_messages_index = 0


def deserialize_sdk_object(d):
    """Reconstruct SDK objects from cassette dicts."""
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or "__type__" not in d:
        return d
    import claude_agent_sdk.types as sdk_types
    type_name = d.pop("__type__")
    cls = getattr(sdk_types, type_name, None)
    if cls is None:
        return d
    try:
        return cls(**d)
    except TypeError:
        obj = object.__new__(cls)
        for k, v in d.items():
            setattr(obj, k, v)
        return obj


async def mock_query(**kwargs):
    """Replay recorded query interactions from cassette."""
    global _mock_query_index
    queries = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"] if i["call"] == "query"]
    if _mock_query_index >= len(queries):
        raise RuntimeError("Cassette exhausted: no more query interactions")
    interaction = queries[_mock_query_index]
    _mock_query_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: query [{_mock_query_index}/{len(queries)}]")
    prompt = kwargs.get("prompt")
    if prompt is not None:
        async for _ in prompt:
            pass
    for msg_dict in interaction["yielded"]:
        yield deserialize_sdk_object(msg_dict)


def mock_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs):
    """Replay recorded list_sessions from cassette."""
    global _mock_list_sessions_index
    calls = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"] if i["call"] == "list_sessions"]
    if _mock_list_sessions_index >= len(calls):
        return []
    interaction = calls[_mock_list_sessions_index]
    _mock_list_sessions_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: list_sessions [{_mock_list_sessions_index}/{len(calls)}]")
    return [deserialize_sdk_object(s) for s in interaction["returned"]]


def mock_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs):
    """Replay recorded get_session_messages from cassette."""
    global _mock_get_session_messages_index
    calls = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"]
             if i["call"] == "get_session_messages"]
    if _mock_get_session_messages_index >= len(calls):
        return []
    interaction = calls[_mock_get_session_messages_index]
    _mock_get_session_messages_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: get_session_messages [{_mock_get_session_messages_index}/{len(calls)}]")
    return [deserialize_sdk_object(m) for m in interaction["returned"]]


def install_sdk_mock():
    """Replace SDK functions with cassette playback."""
    import claude_agent_sdk
    claude_agent_sdk.query = mock_query
    claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions = mock_list_sessions
    claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages = mock_get_session_messages
    real_app.query = mock_query
    real_app.list_sessions = mock_list_sessions
    real_app.get_session_messages = mock_get_session_messages


def uninstall_sdk_mock(saved):
    """Restore SDK functions from saved references."""
    import claude_agent_sdk
    for attr in ("query", "list_sessions", "get_session_messages"):
        setattr(claude_agent_sdk, attr, saved[attr])
        setattr(real_app, attr, saved[attr])

Page reload helper

fresh_page reloads the page and waits for Alpine.js to initialize (signaled by the textarea becoming visible). This gives each test a clean DOM state.

def fresh_page(page):
    """Reload and wait for Alpine to initialize."""
    page.reload()
    page.wait_for_selector("textarea")

SDK tests

These tests exercise the claude_agent_sdk directly.

def test_sdk_send_message(page):
    """Send a message and get a response."""
    fresh_page(page)
    page.locator("textarea").fill("Say only the word 'pong'. Nothing else.")
    page.locator("button:text('Send')").click()
    page.wait_for_selector("text=Claude", timeout=60000)
    page.wait_for_selector("button:text('Send')", timeout=60000)
    print("  PASS: sdk send message")


def test_sdk_session_list(page):
    """Sessions appear in the sidebar."""
    fresh_page(page)
    import requests as http_requests
    base = page.url.rstrip("/")
    token = page.locator("meta[name=app-token]").get_attribute("content")
    r = http_requests.get(f"{base}/api/sessions", headers={"X-App-Token": token})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    sessions = r.json()
    if not sessions:
        print("  SKIP: sdk session list (no sessions)")
        return
    s = sessions[0]
    for key in ("session_id", "summary", "last_modified"):
        assert key in s, f"Session missing key '{key}': {s}"
    print(f"  PASS: sdk session list ({len(sessions)} sessions)")
    print(f"    Sample session keys: {list(s.keys())}")

Test runner


TESTS = [
    test_page_loads,
    test_sidebar_elements,
    test_new_chat,
    test_send_text_message,
    test_loading_indicator,
    test_error_display,
    test_session_list,
    test_session_history,
    test_image_upload_button,
    test_image_preview_and_remove,
    test_image_sent_in_request,
    test_images_displayed_in_chat,
    test_image_only_message,
    test_streaming_text,
    test_send_disabled_when_empty,
    test_token_required_for_api,
    test_invalid_session_id_rejected,
    test_chat_rejects_empty_request,
    test_rate_limiting,
    test_new_chat_resets_session,
    test_timestamps_displayed,
    test_resume_passes_cwd,
    test_cancel_query,
    test_cancel_no_query,
    test_sdk_send_message,
    test_sdk_session_list,
]

def main():
    tests = TESTS
    if TEST_FILTERS:
        tests = [t for t in tests if any(f in t.__name__ for f in TEST_FILTERS)]
        if not tests:
            print(f"No tests matching {TEST_FILTERS}")
            sys.exit(1)

    base_url = start_server()
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless="--headed" not in sys.argv)
        context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1024, "height": 768})
        page = context.new_page()
        page.goto(base_url)
        page.wait_for_selector("textarea")

        passed = 0
        failed = 0
        for test_fn in tests:
            name = test_fn.__name__
            try:
                with sdk_test(name):
                    test_fn(page)
                passed += 1
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  FAIL: {name}: {e}")
                failed += 1

        browser.close()

    print(f"\n{'='*40}")
    print(f"Results: {passed} passed, {failed} failed out of {len(tests)}")
    print(f"{'='*40}")
    sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    deadline = time.time() + timeout
    while time.time() < deadline:
        r = barrier_requests.get(f"{base_url}/api/debug/state")
        if r.json()["state"] == state:
            return
        time.sleep(0.05)
    raise TimeoutError(f"App never reached state '{state}'")


def resume_app(base_url):
    """Release the app from its current barrier."""
    barrier_requests.post(f"{base_url}/api/debug/resume")
@contextmanager
def sdk_test(name):
    """Reset app state and manage cassette mock/record per test."""
    global _cassette_interactions
    global _mock_cassette, _mock_query_index
    global _mock_list_sessions_index, _mock_get_session_messages_index
    try:
        real_app._chat_last_request = 0.0
        if real_app._chat_semaphore.locked():
            real_app._chat_semaphore.release()
        real_app._current_query_task = None
    except Exception:
        pass
    cassette_dir = os.environ.get("RC_CASSETTE_DIR")
    mock_active = False
    recording = False
    saved_funcs = {
        attr: getattr(real_app, attr)
        for attr in ("query", "list_sessions", "get_session_messages")
    }
    if cassette_dir:
        cassette_path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
        if os.path.exists(cassette_path):
            with open(cassette_path) as f:
                _mock_cassette = json.load(f)
            _mock_query_index = 0
            _mock_list_sessions_index = 0
            _mock_get_session_messages_index = 0
            install_sdk_mock()
            mock_active = True
            print(f"  MOCK: {cassette_path}")
        else:
            _cassette_interactions = []
            _cassette_query_done.set()
            install_sdk_recorder()
            recording = True
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        if mock_active:
            uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
            _mock_cassette = None
        if recording and _cassette_interactions is not None:
            _cassette_query_done.wait(timeout=30)
            os.makedirs(cassette_dir, exist_ok=True)
            path = os.path.join(cassette_dir, f"{name}.cassette.json")
            with open(path, "w") as f:
                json.dump({
                    "test_name": name,
                    "recorded_at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                    "interactions": _cassette_interactions,
                }, f, indent=2, default=str)
            print(f"  RECORDED: {path}")
            uninstall_sdk_mock(saved_funcs)
        _cassette_interactions = None
def fresh_page(page):
    """Reload and wait for Alpine to initialize."""
    page.reload()
    page.wait_for_selector("textarea")
_cassette_interactions = None
_cassette_pending_queries = 0
_cassette_query_done = threading.Event()
_original_query = None
_original_list_sessions = None
_original_get_session_messages = None


def serialize_sdk_object(obj):
    """Serialize SDK dataclass instances to JSON-compatible dicts."""
    if dataclasses.is_dataclass(obj) and not isinstance(obj, type):
        d = dataclasses.asdict(obj)
        d["__type__"] = type(obj).__name__
        return d
    if isinstance(obj, (list, tuple)):
        return [serialize_sdk_object(item) for item in obj]
    return obj


async def recording_query(**kwargs):
    prompt_iter = kwargs.get("prompt")
    prompt_messages = []

    async def recording_prompt_iter():
        async for msg in prompt_iter:
            prompt_messages.append(
                serialize_sdk_object(msg) if dataclasses.is_dataclass(msg) else msg
            )
            yield msg

    new_kwargs = dict(kwargs)
    if prompt_iter is not None:
        new_kwargs["prompt"] = recording_prompt_iter()

    # Record eagerly: create the interaction entry up front so it's
    # visible even if the cassette is written from another thread
    # before the generator finishes cleanup.
    global _cassette_pending_queries
    options = kwargs.get("options")
    options_dict = serialize_sdk_object(options) if options else {}
    for key in ("stderr", "debug_stderr"):
        options_dict.pop(key, None)
    interaction = {
        "call": "query",
        "args": {"prompt": prompt_messages, "options": options_dict},
        "yielded": [],
    }
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append(interaction)
        _cassette_pending_queries += 1
        _cassette_query_done.clear()

    try:
        async for message in _original_query(**new_kwargs):
            interaction["yielded"].append(serialize_sdk_object(message))
            yield message
    finally:
        if _cassette_interactions is not None:
            _cassette_pending_queries -= 1
            if _cassette_pending_queries <= 0:
                _cassette_query_done.set()


def recording_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs):
    result = _original_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs)
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append({
            "call": "list_sessions",
            "args": {"limit": kwargs.get("limit", args[0] if args else None)},
            "returned": [serialize_sdk_object(s) for s in result],
        })
    return result


def recording_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs):
    result = _original_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs)
    if _cassette_interactions is not None:
        _cassette_interactions.append({
            "call": "get_session_messages",
            "args": {"session_id": session_id},
            "returned": [serialize_sdk_object(m) for m in result],
        })
    return result


def install_sdk_recorder():
    global _original_query, _original_list_sessions, _original_get_session_messages
    import claude_agent_sdk

    _original_query = claude_agent_sdk.query
    _original_list_sessions = claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions
    _original_get_session_messages = claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages

    claude_agent_sdk.query = recording_query
    claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions = recording_list_sessions
    claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages = recording_get_session_messages

    real_app.query = recording_query
    real_app.list_sessions = recording_list_sessions
    real_app.get_session_messages = recording_get_session_messages


_mock_cassette = None
_mock_query_index = 0
_mock_list_sessions_index = 0
_mock_get_session_messages_index = 0


def deserialize_sdk_object(d):
    """Reconstruct SDK objects from cassette dicts."""
    if not isinstance(d, dict) or "__type__" not in d:
        return d
    import claude_agent_sdk.types as sdk_types
    type_name = d.pop("__type__")
    cls = getattr(sdk_types, type_name, None)
    if cls is None:
        return d
    try:
        return cls(**d)
    except TypeError:
        obj = object.__new__(cls)
        for k, v in d.items():
            setattr(obj, k, v)
        return obj


async def mock_query(**kwargs):
    """Replay recorded query interactions from cassette."""
    global _mock_query_index
    queries = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"] if i["call"] == "query"]
    if _mock_query_index >= len(queries):
        raise RuntimeError("Cassette exhausted: no more query interactions")
    interaction = queries[_mock_query_index]
    _mock_query_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: query [{_mock_query_index}/{len(queries)}]")
    prompt = kwargs.get("prompt")
    if prompt is not None:
        async for _ in prompt:
            pass
    for msg_dict in interaction["yielded"]:
        yield deserialize_sdk_object(msg_dict)


def mock_list_sessions(*args, **kwargs):
    """Replay recorded list_sessions from cassette."""
    global _mock_list_sessions_index
    calls = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"] if i["call"] == "list_sessions"]
    if _mock_list_sessions_index >= len(calls):
        return []
    interaction = calls[_mock_list_sessions_index]
    _mock_list_sessions_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: list_sessions [{_mock_list_sessions_index}/{len(calls)}]")
    return [deserialize_sdk_object(s) for s in interaction["returned"]]


def mock_get_session_messages(session_id, *args, **kwargs):
    """Replay recorded get_session_messages from cassette."""
    global _mock_get_session_messages_index
    calls = [i for i in _mock_cassette["interactions"]
             if i["call"] == "get_session_messages"]
    if _mock_get_session_messages_index >= len(calls):
        return []
    interaction = calls[_mock_get_session_messages_index]
    _mock_get_session_messages_index += 1
    print(f"    MOCK replay: get_session_messages [{_mock_get_session_messages_index}/{len(calls)}]")
    return [deserialize_sdk_object(m) for m in interaction["returned"]]


def install_sdk_mock():
    """Replace SDK functions with cassette playback."""
    import claude_agent_sdk
    claude_agent_sdk.query = mock_query
    claude_agent_sdk.list_sessions = mock_list_sessions
    claude_agent_sdk.get_session_messages = mock_get_session_messages
    real_app.query = mock_query
    real_app.list_sessions = mock_list_sessions
    real_app.get_session_messages = mock_get_session_messages


def uninstall_sdk_mock(saved):
    """Restore SDK functions from saved references."""
    import claude_agent_sdk
    for attr in ("query", "list_sessions", "get_session_messages"):
        setattr(claude_agent_sdk, attr, saved[attr])
        setattr(real_app, attr, saved[attr])

def test_rate_limiting(page):
    """Concurrent chat requests get 429."""
    import requests as http_requests
    fresh_page(page)
    base = page.url.rstrip("/")
    token = page.locator("meta[name=app-token]").get_attribute("content")
    headers = {"X-App-Token": token, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    body = {"prompt": "Say only 'ok'"}
    # Send r1 streaming, then immediately send r2 while r1 is in progress
    r1 = http_requests.post(f"{base}/api/chat", headers=headers, json=body, stream=True)
    assert r1.status_code == 200, f"First request should succeed, got {r1.status_code}"
    # r1 is still streaming — second request hits concurrency limit
    r2 = http_requests.post(f"{base}/api/chat", headers=headers, json=body)
    assert r2.status_code == 429, f"Expected 429 for concurrent request, got {r2.status_code}"
    # Consume r1 fully so server-side query finishes and releases semaphore
    for _ in r1.iter_content():
        pass
    r1.close()
    print("  PASS: rate limiting")

    fresh_page(page)
    page.locator("textarea").fill("Say only the word 'pong'. Nothing else.")
    page.locator("button:text('Send')").click()
    page.wait_for_selector("text=Claude", timeout=60000)
    page.wait_for_selector("button:text('Send')", timeout=60000)
    print("  PASS: sdk send message")


def test_sdk_session_list(page):
    """Sessions appear in the sidebar."""
    fresh_page(page)
    import requests as http_requests
    base = page.url.rstrip("/")
    token = page.locator("meta[name=app-token]").get_attribute("content")
    r = http_requests.get(f"{base}/api/sessions", headers={"X-App-Token": token})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    sessions = r.json()
    if not sessions:
        print("  SKIP: sdk session list (no sessions)")
        return
    s = sessions[0]
    for key in ("session_id", "summary", "last_modified"):
        assert key in s, f"Session missing key '{key}': {s}"
    print(f"  PASS: sdk session list ({len(sessions)} sessions)")
    print(f"    Sample session keys: {list(s.keys())}")

TESTS = [
    test_page_loads,
    test_sidebar_elements,
    test_new_chat,
    test_send_text_message,
    test_loading_indicator,
    test_error_display,
    test_session_list,
    test_session_history,
    test_image_upload_button,
    test_image_preview_and_remove,
    test_image_sent_in_request,
    test_images_displayed_in_chat,
    test_image_only_message,
    test_streaming_text,
    test_send_disabled_when_empty,
    test_token_required_for_api,
    test_invalid_session_id_rejected,
    test_chat_rejects_empty_request,
    test_rate_limiting,
    test_new_chat_resets_session,
    test_timestamps_displayed,
    test_resume_passes_cwd,
    test_cancel_query,
    test_cancel_no_query,
    test_sdk_send_message,
    test_sdk_session_list,
]

def main():
    tests = TESTS
    if TEST_FILTERS:
        tests = [t for t in tests if any(f in t.__name__ for f in TEST_FILTERS)]
        if not tests:
            print(f"No tests matching {TEST_FILTERS}")
            sys.exit(1)

    base_url = start_server()
    with sync_playwright() as pw:
        browser = pw.chromium.launch(headless="--headed" not in sys.argv)
        context = browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1024, "height": 768})
        page = context.new_page()
        page.goto(base_url)
        page.wait_for_selector("textarea")

        passed = 0
        failed = 0
        for test_fn in tests:
            name = test_fn.__name__
            try:
                with sdk_test(name):
                    test_fn(page)
                passed += 1
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  FAIL: {name}: {e}")
                failed += 1

        browser.close()

    print(f"\n{'='*40}")
    print(f"Results: {passed} passed, {failed} failed out of {len(tests)}")
    print(f"{'='*40}")
    sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
